subject: Residency + KMS/HSM + Audit-log evidence playbook — workshop notes and pricing
content:
From: Alice Keller <alice.keller@mountainhealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@mountainhealth.com, kevin.yang@mountainhealth.com, legal@mountainhealth.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Residency + KMS/HSM + Audit-log evidence — initial ask

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Mountain Health is lining up three items we need clarified to move to a commercial commitment:

1) Clear pricing split for data residency (EU vs US), and whether residency is a recurring surcharge or a one-time migration fee.
2) KMS/HSM options — we need seat-based vs pass-through hardware pricing and whether HSM attestation is included.
3) Audit/Evidence delivery plan — sample artifacts, delivery cadence, and estimated effort/cost for providing evidence during procurement and for future audits.

Can you share a concise playbook we can use internally and pass to procurement/legal? Also, what flexibility is there for a 3-year commitment versus a 12-mo pilot on credits/discounts?

Appreciate a short workshop we can run with your team and our security/procurement leads. Proposed window: Dec 2 or Dec 3 (PST).

Best,
Alice
Alice Keller
Procurement Manager, Mountain Health

---
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Alice Keller <alice.keller@mountainhealth.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, mina.haddad@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 16:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Residency + KMS/HSM + Audit-log evidence — initial ask

Hi Alice — thanks for outlining this. Attaching a short playbook that maps the artifacts and the typical pricing levers we use. High-level answers here and we can cover the rest in the workshop: 

- Residency pricing: recurring surcharge model by region (monthly % uplift on hosted usage) OR one-time migration fee for on-prem/VPC installs. For Mountain Health-sized commitments we can blend a smaller recurring uplift (3–6%) with a migration credit spread over 12 months.

- KMS/HSM: three paths — managed KMS (Redwood-managed keys), customer-managed KMS (bring-your-own-KMS via customer cloud account), and certified HSM (FIPS 140-2/3-backed HSM appliances or cloud HSM). HSM is typically priced as an annual seat + pass-through hardware fees if on-prem; for cloud HSM we model as an annual license plus a per-transaction surcharge for key ops.

- Audit/evidence: we provide a standard evidence bundle (SOC-like artifacts, operational playbooks, audit-log extracts) and can commit to a one-time procurement package delivery + a paid annual evidence subscription for ad-hoc requests and deeper forensic pulls. Typical procurement package is 2–3 deliverables (PDFs + CSV extracts) included in the onboarding; ongoing evidence support is billed quarterly or consumed against an evidence credit pool.

I've attached: Redwood_Evidence_Playbook.pdf (short, 6pp), SOW_Draft_MountainHealth.xlsx (initial cost split), HIPAA_SLA_Addendum.docx (draft language).

We can do a 45-min workshop on Dec 2 at 10:00am PST. If that works we'll send a calendar invite and a short pre-read.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Head of Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com | +1 415 555 0198

Attachments: Redwood_Evidence_Playbook.pdf; SOW_Draft_MountainHealth.xlsx; HIPAA_SLA_Addendum.docx

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:14:00 -08:00
Subject: Internal: pre-workshop pricing notes (confidential)

Team — quick notes ahead of today's workshop with Mountain Health:

- Pricing anchor: prospect expects strong unit economics pressure; for a 3-year deal we should target a blended uplift (residency + HSM) discount of ~15–22% vs list, delivered via a combination of upfront implementation credit + reduced recurring uplift.
- Evidence delivery: include 8 hours of evidence support per quarter in year 1; additional pulls at $250/hr or draw from a 40-hour evidence credit pool at $9k for the year.
- HSM seat: propose $18,000/seat/yr for on-prem HSM attestation + $0.0015 per key-op for high-volume signing operations (benchmarks included in SOW).
- Migration fee vs recurring: suggest push for a smaller migration fee (one-time) that buys down recurring uplift by ~2%. Put conservative numbers in SOW so legal has room.

Action items before workshop:
1) Laura — confirm the backup pricing schedule and an example invoice layout (so procurement sees how it hits their P&L).
2) Mina — prepare 1 slide that explains evidence playbook + expected timelines for each artifact.
3) Jonas — bring negotiation collar for discounts by ARR anchors (pilot -> enterprise).

Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Enterprise Economics | Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Alice Keller <alice.keller@mountainhealth.com>
Cc: procurement@mountainhealth.com, kevin.yang@mountainhealth.com, legal@mountainhealth.com
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 11:28:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Residency + KMS/HSM + Audit-log evidence — initial ask

Thanks Alice — confirmed for Dec 2 at 10:00am PST. Agenda and pre-reads below.

Workshop agenda (45m):
- 0–5m: Introductions and scope
- 5–20m: Pricing options (residency uplift vs migration fee; KMS/HSM paths)
- 20–35m: Evidence playbook walkthrough (what procurement/legal will get)
- 35–40m: Commercial proposals, discounts, and contract cadence
- 40–45m: Next steps / decision calendar

Pre-reads attached: Redwood_Evidence_Playbook.pdf, SOW_Draft_MountainHealth.xlsx (pricing rows highlighted).

Key clarifications for Mountain Health: procurement typically needs line-item visibility (how evidence costs are allocated across onboarding vs recurring) and legal needs the HIPAA addendum redline we provided. We should be prepared to offer a one-time 50% onboarding credit on evidence delivery hours if they commit to a 36-month term and commit to a minimum monthly usage floor.

Laura Bennett
Head of Pricing & Packaging | Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_Evidence_Playbook.pdf; SOW_Draft_MountainHealth.xlsx

Thanks everyone — workshop was useful. A few follow-ups from our side: 

- Can you convert the SOW spreadsheet into a one-page summary for our CFO showing ARR impact and the split between recurring uplift vs one-time migration fees? (we need this by EOD Monday).
- For HSM seat pricing, Kevin asked whether attestation reports and up-to-date firmware evidence are included or if that is a separate charge.
- Legal wants to see the HIPAA addendum with the redlines applied (we'll send our markups).

Next steps: Jonas — will you own the one-pager? Laura — can you confirm attestation line item and whether we can bundle firmware attestation into the first year seats at no charge for a 36-month commitment?

Regards,
Alice

Got it — I'll produce the CFO one-pager (ARR impact + payment timing) by EOD Monday and loop in finance for invoice illustrations.

Laura — per the HSM attestation question: we can include the initial attestation report and firmware snapshot in year 1 for up to 3 seats as part of the onboarding credit if Mountain Health signs a 36-month deal and takes a minimum committed monthly usage. Beyond that, ongoing firmware attestation/patch verification can be added to the evidence subscription or purchased as a discrete professional service. Can you confirm language we can include in the HIPAA addendum and a price line we slot into the SOW?

Mina — can you prepare a single-slide evidence timeline and the example artifacts we promised (audit-log CSV sample, key rotation diary, export checklist) — attach to the one-pager if possible.

I'll draft the calendar invite for the follow-ups and upload the one-pager to the HubSpot deal record.

Thanks,
Jonas
